DuplicateKeyError.root_cause: The clinics collection has a unique compound index on (city_slug, clinic_slug). When creating a new clinic account from an approved application, the clinic_doc doesn't include these fields, resulting in null values. Since there's already a clinic with null city_slug and clinic_slug, MongoDB throws DuplicateKeyError.
DuplicateKeyError.mitigation: Add city_slug and clinic_slug fields to clinic_doc in update_clinic_application endpoint. Use application['city'] to derive city_slug (e.g., slugify the city name) and generate a unique clinic_slug.

AdminUser_ValidationError.root_cause: The get_current_user function creates AdminUser with username from JWT payload. Clinic tokens have 'email' instead of 'username', causing Pydantic validation error when clinic token is used on admin endpoints.
reproduction_steps: 2. Try to access /api/admin/clinic-accounts with clinic token
AdminUser_ValidationError.mitigation: Add role check at the beginning of get_current_user to return 403 if role != 'admin', or handle missing username gracefully.
